import pandas as pd
trips = tables['trips']
climate = tables['climate']
pier = tables['pier']

# ONI last few months
oni = climate[climate.index_id=='oni'].sort_values('avail_t')
result_oni = oni.tail(8)[['avail_doy','value']]

# water temp last 14 days (season2)
p = pier[(pier.ts_season==2)].sort_values('ts_t')
temp_recent = p.tail(14*4)[['ts_doy','wtmp_c']]  # rough

# fleet-wide overnight/day_1_5 season2 last 30 days by fish_date_doy
t2 = trips[trips.fished_date_season==2]
ov = t2[t2.cls.isin(['overnight','day_1_5'])]
ov_recent = ov[ov.fished_date_doy>=100].groupby('fished_date_doy').apply(lambda g: pd.Series({'yt':g.yt.sum(),'anglers':g.anglers.sum(),'n':len(g)}))

# three_quarter fleet wide last 20 days
tq = t2[t2.cls=='three_quarter']
tq_recent = tq[tq.fished_date_doy>=130].groupby('fished_date_doy').apply(lambda g: pd.Series({'yt':g.yt.sum(),'anglers':g.anglers.sum(),'share':g.yt.sum()/g.anglers.sum() if g.anglers.sum()>0 else 0,'n':len(g)}))

# San Diego boat specifically last 20 trips
sd = t2[(t2.boat=='San Diego')].sort_values('fished_date_doy')
sd_recent = sd.tail(15)[['fished_date_doy','cls','yt','anglers']]

# season1 same doy window (100-160) for overnight/day1.5 comparison
t1 = trips[trips.fished_date_season==1]
ov1 = t1[t1.cls.isin(['overnight','day_1_5']) & (t1.fished_date_doy.between(100,200))]
ov1_summary = ov1.groupby('fished_date_doy').apply(lambda g: pd.Series({'yt':g.yt.sum(),'anglers':g.anglers.sum()}))

result = {
 'oni_recent': result_oni.to_dict('records'),
 'temp_recent_tail': temp_recent.tail(20).to_dict('records'),
 'ov_recent_doy100plus': ov_recent.to_dict('index'),
 'tq_recent': tq_recent.to_dict('index'),
 'san_diego_recent': sd_recent.to_dict('records'),
 'season1_ov_doy100_200': ov1_summary.to_dict('index'),
}
